errors.name: DuplicateSplitEntry
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when two canonical entries use the same account and label.

errors.name: InvalidEntryCount
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a split profile has zero entries or exceeds the entry limit.

errors.name: InvalidSplitAccount
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a split entry account is the zero address.

errors.name: InvalidSplitShare
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a split entry share is zero or above the denominator.

errors.name: InvalidSplitTotal
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when split entry shares do not sum to the denominator.

errors.name: InvalidAssetPolicyRegistry
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the factory is initialized with an invalid asset policy registry.

errors.name: SplitWalletAddressPoisoned
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the deterministic wallet address already has unexpected code.

errors.name: UnknownProfile
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a caller asks to deploy a profile that does not exist.

events.name: SplitProfileCreated
events.natspec: @notice Emitted once when a canonical split profile is first created.

events.name: SplitProfileEntry
events.natspec: @notice Emitted for each canonical label-level split entry in a created profile.

events.name: SplitWalletDeployed
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when the factory deploys a split wallet for a profile.

events.name: SplitWalletDiscovered
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when the factory records a pre-existing wallet with expected code.

events.name: AssetPolicyRegistryPinned
events.natspec: @notice Emitted once when the factory pins its deployment-wide asset policy registry.

functions.name: PROFILE_DOMAIN
functions.natspec: @notice Domain separator label for profile identifiers.

functions.name: SCHEMA_VERSION
functions.natspec: @notice Split profile schema version.

functions.name: WALLET_VERSION
functions.natspec: @notice Split wallet implementation version.

functions.name: MAX_ENTRIES
functions.natspec: @notice Maximum label-level entries in one profile.

functions.name: MAX_UNIQUE_ACCOUNTS
functions.natspec: @notice Maximum unique account aggregates in one profile.

functions.name: SHARE_DENOMINATOR_PPM
functions.natspec: @notice Parts-per-million share denominator.

functions.name: assetPolicyRegistry
functions.natspec: @notice Deployment-wide asset policy registry pinned for split-wallet ERC-20 support.

functions.name: splitWalletInitCodeHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the wallet creation-code hash used by CREATE2.

functions.name: splitWalletRuntimeCodeHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the wallet runtime-code hash accepted after deployment.

functions.name: createProfile
functions.natspec: @notice Creates or reuses a split profile and deploys its wallet.

functions.name: deployWallet
functions.natspec: @notice Deploys the wallet for an existing profile.

functions.name: profileExists
functions.natspec: @notice Returns true when a profile exists.

functions.name: splitWalletExists
functions.natspec: @notice Returns true when the profile wallet is deployed with expected code and metadata.

functions.name: profileMetadataURIHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the metadata URI hash committed by a profile.

functions.name: profileEntriesHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the canonical entries hash committed by a profile.

functions.name: walletFor
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the deterministic wallet address for a profile.

functions.name: profileIdFor
functions.natspec: @notice Computes a profile identifier for entries and metadata.

functions.name: profileEntryCount
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the canonical entry count for a profile.

functions.name: profileEntry
functions.natspec: @notice Returns one canonical profile entry by index.

functions.name: profileUniqueAccountCount
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the unique account count for a profile.

functions.name: profileUniqueAccount
functions.natspec: @notice Returns one unique account and aggregate share by index.
